policy.search_scope: executable section raw bytes only; overlapping matches retained
policy.multiple_hits: record multi_hit; selected_rva=null, never select first
policy.one_hit: unique_raw_candidate only, not live/runtime validation; selected_rva=null
policy.decode_rule: RIP: instruction RVA + size + signed displacement; direct branch: instruction RVA + size + signed immediate; SIB disp is image anchor only with established image-base register.
policy.never: No process attach, memory write, patch, engine modification, RVA fallback, or inferred uniform delta.
